input.goal: Lose fat while keeping my strength

goalSpec.text: How my clothes fit, strength kept

input.baseline: I lift twice a week. Bench press 60 kg for 5 reps. I track my meals.

asked.question: Is there something you'd like to watch?

options.rationale: A gradual 12-week strength-training route that keeps your stated bench press load in the plan and uses clothes fit and strength as tracking markers. It does not promise a particular change in body composition.
assumptions: The baseline does not state session length, so planned sessions are 45 minutes; adjust to match your usual safe session length.
Use the bench press load and repetitions you reported; no meal or body-weight target is added.
Track clothes fit consistently and log bench press load and reps to monitor the outcomes you named.

phases.title: Establish a consistent routine
phases.progressCheck: Log each session's duration, bench press load and reps; note clothes fit once a week under similar conditions.

phases.title: Build gradually
phases.progressCheck: Continue weekly clothes-fit notes and compare logged bench press loads and reps with week 1.

phases.title: Consolidate and review
phases.progressCheck: Review clothes-fit notes and strength logs across the 12 weeks; record whether strength was maintained.
